solution_summary: SymphonyAI built its Microsoft solution to improve fraud-investigation workflows. "Strong risk assessment helps prevent financial crime, reduces losses, and supports a healthy financial ecosystem. Key components included Azure OpenAI Service ran model inference or heavy processing, and Azure Kubernetes Service coordinated workflows, prompts, or deployment. User prompts and domain content are orchestrated through Azure OpenAI Service, processed by Azure OpenAI Service, and then delivered through Azure Kubernetes Service so SymphonyAI can return context-aware answers or automation in the flow of work. The governed Microsoft stack gave SymphonyAI a reusable foundation for generative ai / llm, ai and machine learning while keeping deployment, security, and day-to-day operations inside the Microsoft estate.
